test.name: Routes a hint-review request to the search-hints agent
test.description: The user asks /research to check the FamilySearch hints on Patrick Flynn (LZNY-BRF). A hint review is an entry point, not a downstream destination (research/SKILL.md, "Hint review"): the router spawns @plugin:search-hints with personId and projectPath, relays its triage, and stops for the researcher's verdicts. search-hints is stubbed because the router does not read its return. e2e can never reach this route (person_record_matches is in BLOCKED_TREE_TOOLS), so this test is its only check (issue #2029).

judge_context: This is a ROUTING test. The only assertion that matters is whether @plugin:search-hints is the first hand-off. A deterministic validator (test_routes_to_expected_skill) owns that check — do not grade the routing decision yourself.
The delegation should carry personId (LZNY-BRF) and projectPath, and no accept/reject verdicts — none was stated by the researcher.
search-hints is stubbed and returns a bare denial. Grade only the router's own work: whether its narration is honest about what it delegated, and that it does not adjudicate the hints itself.

ROUTING IS NOT YOURS TO GRADE. The hand-off is asserted deterministically by test_routes_to_expected_skill, which reads the PreToolUse hook records. Do NOT score Correctness or Completeness on whether the router reached the right callee.
